posts.title: Fix a blocked upload
posts.hook: File upload rejected for size, format, or photo dimensions?
posts.body: Start with the upload limit fixer. It points to the no-upload PDF compressor, image-to-KB compressor, image resizer, passport photo cropper, PDF-to-JPG converter, and image-to-PDF tools.

posts.title: Exam photo under 20KB
posts.body: Use the no-upload image-to-KB compressor with the 20KB target, then review the downloaded JPG before submitting it to the exam, school, or application portal.

posts.title: Fix an ID photo size
posts.hook: Photo rejected for dimensions or file size?
posts.body: Start with the passport photo size fixer. It points to the local crop, resize, and image-to-KB tools so the file can match a portal's photo rules without uploading the original.

posts.title: Upload limit fix: PDF under 1MB
posts.hook: Portal says your PDF must be under 1MB?
posts.body: Open the no-upload PDF compressor, choose the 1MB target, select your PDF, and download a smaller copy from the browser. It works best for scans and image-heavy PDFs.

posts.title: Image under 100KB
posts.hook: Job form rejecting your photo because it is over 100KB?
posts.body: Use the local image-to-KB compressor, pick 100KB, and download a smaller JPG or WebP without uploading the original photo.

posts.title: No-upload file utility pack
posts.hook: I made a free no-signup file utility site for common upload blockers.
posts.body: It handles PDF compression targets, image-to-KB targets, PDF-to-JPG, image resizing, QR codes, invoices, labels, and small business PDFs in the browser. Downloads are free during validation and not gated behind ad interactions.
posts.cta: Useful feedback is which tool solved a real blocked-upload moment.

posts.title: Directory listing blurb
posts.hook: Free browser PDF, image, and QR tools without signup.
posts.body: PrintableTools Lab helps users create and edit practical files locally: compress PDFs to target sizes, compress images to KB limits, convert PDF pages to JPG, resize and convert images, make static QR codes, and generate invoices, receipts, labels, business cards, and other everyday PDFs.
posts.cta: List as a free productivity and file utility tool.

posts.title: Zero-domain HTML5 game experiment
posts.hook: Upload Limit Panic turns upload limits into a 60-second sorting game.
posts.body: It is a free standalone HTML5 build for platform review: sort files into Compress, Convert, Send, or Trash before the queue bursts. The standalone version has no forced ads; rewarded hooks are optional for future platform SDK approval.
posts.cta: Play the Upload Limit Panic prototype

posts.title: Second zero-domain HTML5 game experiment
posts.hook: Neon Lane Dash is a 45-second lane-switching reflex game.
posts.body: It is a free standalone HTML5 build for platform review: switch lanes, collect sparks, dodge blockers, and use focus for a short slow-road assist. The standalone version has no forced ads; rewarded hooks are optional for future platform SDK approval.
posts.cta: Play the Neon Lane Dash prototype

tasks.title: Helpful reply for PDF under 1MB questions
tasks.trigger: Use only when someone asks how to make a PDF smaller for a job, school, email, or form upload.
tasks.copy: If the portal says your PDF must be under 1MB, this free browser tool can try compressing scans or image-heavy PDFs locally: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/compress-pdf-to-1mb/?utm_source=community&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upload_error_cheatsheet&utm_content=community-pdf-1mb. Check the result before submitting, because very small targets can reduce quality.
tasks.successSignal: One real visitor lands from community UTM and downloads a PDF after the reply.
tasks.riskRule: Do not post in unrelated threads, do not claim guaranteed compression, and do not use private documents as examples.

tasks.title: Helpful reply for 100KB photo upload questions
tasks.trigger: Use when a job, exam, school, or profile form rejects an image because it is over 100KB.

tasks.successSignal: One image-tool visitor arrives from community UTM and triggers a download.
tasks.riskRule: Do not ask users to share IDs, faces, payment documents, or private files publicly.

entries.problem: A job, school, email, or admin portal rejects a PDF by file size.
entries.response: Open the PDF compressor with the 1MB target, compress locally, then review readability before submitting.

entries.problem: A strict form, exam upload, or school portal requires a very small PDF.
entries.response: Use the strict 500KB PDF target and keep the original file in case the compressed copy loses detail.

entries.problem: A profile, marketplace, support, or application page rejects an image over 2MB.
entries.response: Use the image-to-KB compressor with a 2048KB custom target.

entries.problem: A portal or ticket form requires an image below 500KB.
entries.response: Use the 500KB image target, then resize if a large phone photo still misses the limit.

entries.problem: A job, profile, school, or ID-style form rejects a photo by KB size.
entries.response: Use the 100KB image target and check that the face or document text remains clear.

entries.problem: A portal accepts JPG/JPEG but rejects the image as too large.
entries.response: Use the 200KB image target and keep output as JPG if the destination requires it.

entries.problem: A support ticket, admin upload, or bug report rejects a PNG screenshot.
entries.response: Crop private areas first, then compress toward 500KB and review small UI text.

entries.errorText: Invalid file type. Please upload JPG or PNG
entries.problem: A website rejects the current image format and asks for JPG/JPEG/PNG.
entries.response: Convert the image format locally, then compress if the converted file is still too large.

entries.errorText: Image dimensions must be 600 x 600 px
entries.problem: A profile, marketplace, avatar, or product image must match exact pixels.
entries.response: Resize or crop to 600 x 600 pixels, then compress only if the KB limit still fails.

entries.problem: A form accepts images but rejects a PDF upload.
entries.response: Convert PDF pages to JPG/PNG locally and upload the page image the destination expects.

entries.problem: A job application or recruiter portal rejects a resume PDF by size.
entries.response: Try the 1MB PDF target and confirm all resume text remains readable before applying.

entries.problem: Gmail, Outlook, school email, or work mail rejects a document attachment.
entries.response: Compress PDFs toward 5MB or use the image-to-KB tool for photo attachments.
